Urology Oracle — decision support + surgical workstation

Use the Oracle to derive a management pathway from explicit clinical criteria; use the Procedure Atlas for operative sequencing and Calculators for validated scores/metrics. The app intentionally summarizes guideline recommendations; it does not reproduce copyrighted guideline books verbatim.

Clinical safety: Drug doses and algorithms are reference protocols, not patient-specific prescriptions. Confirm current product label, renal/hepatic function, interactions, laboratory criteria, institutional chemotherapy order set, MDT decision and the latest live NCCN/EAU version before treatment.
How the Oracle is structured
1. Diagnose
work-up + accuracy
2. Classify
TNM + histology + grade
3. Stratify
risk groups + prognostic scores
4. Treat
primary → nodes → M1
5. Follow
response + recurrence

Clinical content baseline verified against publicly accessible 2026 EAU pages plus current FDA labeling/public decisions reviewed on 22 September 2026; NCCN professional content remains access-controlled and should be checked live before treatment.
